title: The Woman Caught in Adultery
description: Scribes and Pharisees bring a woman caught in adultery before Jesus in the temple and ask if she should be stoned as the Law of Moses commands. Jesus bends down and writes with his finger on the ground, then says: 'Let him who is without sin among you be the first to throw a stone at her.' One by one, the accusers leave, beginning with the elders. To the woman he says: 'Neither do I condemn you; go, and from now on sin no more.'
